topics.description: Decorrelated retry jitter prevents synchronized reconnect storms
triggers: clients reconnect in one synchronized wave
topics.body: When an outage ends, identical exponential schedules can make every client reconnect together. Use decorrelated jitter and a bounded retry budget to spread the load.

topics.description: A long read transaction can keep a SQLite WAL checkpoint busy
triggers: SQLite WAL 检查点 忙
数据库 写入 阻塞 检查点
topics.body: 长时间未提交的读事务会阻止 WAL 检查点推进并拖慢写入。先结束读事务，再重新执行检查点，不要删除 WAL 文件。

topics.description: Keychain accessibility changes require a read-copy-delete migration
triggers: 鑰匙圈 可存取性 遷移
裝置鎖定後 讀不到 憑證
topics.body: 變更鑰匙圈項目的可存取性不會自動更新既有資料。應讀取舊項目、以新屬性寫入，再刪除舊項目，避免裝置鎖定後無法讀取憑證。

topics.description: UI state published from a background task must return to MainActor
triggers: バックグラウンド 状態変更 警告
画面更新 メインスレッド
topics.body: バックグラウンド処理の完了後に画面状態を更新する場合は MainActor に戻す。非同期タスクから直接 published state を変更しない。

topics.description: Android WorkManager jobs need a unique-work policy to prevent duplicates
triggers: 앱 재시작 백그라운드 작업 두 번
topics.body: 앱 재시작 때 같은 백그라운드 작업이 두 번 예약되면 고유 작업 이름과 ExistingWorkPolicy를 사용한다. 태그만으로는 중복 실행을 막지 못한다.

topics.description: A schema migration should roll back atomically when data copying fails
triggers: copia de datos falla a mitad
topics.body: Ejecuta el cambio de esquema y la copia de datos dentro de una transacción. Si falla una fila, revierte toda la migración y conserva la versión anterior.

topics.description: Single-flight request coalescing prevents a cache stampede
topics.body: Quand une entrée expire, regrouper les demandes concurrentes autour d'une seule requête de remplissage. Les autres attendent le même résultat au lieu de surcharger le service d'origine.

topics.description: Certificate pin rotation needs an overlap window for old and new keys
topics.body: Bei der Pin-Rotation müssen alter und neuer öffentlicher Schlüssel während eines Übergangsfensters gültig sein. Erst nach dem App-Rollout darf der alte Pin entfernt werden.

topics.description: Cursor pagination requires a stable tie-breaker to avoid duplicate rows
topics.body: Use uma ordenação estável com um desempate único, como created_at mais id. Um cursor baseado apenas no horário pode repetir ou pular itens entre páginas.

topics.description: Signed API requests need a bounded clock-skew policy
topics.body: إذا رُفض الطلب الموقّع بسبب اختلاف الوقت، قِس انحراف ساعة الجهاز وطبّق نافذة زمنية محدودة. لا تعطّل التحقق من الطابع الزمني.

topics.description: Payment webhooks must use an idempotency key before applying side effects
triggers: एक ही घटना से दो रसीद
topics.body: प्रदाता एक भुगतान वेबहुक कई बार भेज सकता है। दुष्प्रभाव लागू करने से पहले घटना आईडी को इडेम्पोटेंसी कुंजी के रूप में संग्रहित करें, ताकि दो रसीद न बनें।

topics.description: Retries need exponential backoff, a cap, and a total attempt budget
topics.body: Gunakan backoff eksponensial dengan jeda maksimum dan anggaran percobaan total. Retry tanpa batas memperpanjang gangguan dan membebani layanan yang sedang pulih.

topics.description: Unicode filename normalization can differ across filesystems
triggers: файл существует но путь не совпадает
topics.body: Файловые системы могут хранить визуально одинаковые имена в NFC или NFD. Нормализуйте сравниваемые строки, но открывайте фактическое имя из каталога.

topics.description: A poison queue message should move to a dead-letter queue after bounded retries
triggers: ข้อความเสียค้างคิว
คิวจดหมายตาย
ลองประมวลผลซ้ำไม่สิ้นสุด
topics.body: เมื่อข้อความเดิมประมวลผลล้มเหลวซ้ำจนเกินจำนวนที่กำหนด ให้ย้ายไปคิวจดหมายตายพร้อมสาเหตุ อย่าปล่อยให้ข้อความเสียกีดขวางคิวหลัก

topics.description: Turkish dotted and dotless I need locale-aware identifier handling
triggers: I ı ve İ i eşleştirme
topics.body: Türkçe metinde İ, i, I ve ı aynı dönüşümü izlemez. Kullanıcı görünen metnini yerel kuralla karşılaştırın; protokol kimliklerini sabit ve belgelenmiş bir kuralla normalleştirin.

topics.description: Optimistic concurrency must surface a version conflict instead of overwriting
triggers: xung đột phiên bản lạc quan
hai người sửa cùng bản ghi
ghi đè thay đổi mới hơn
topics.body: Khi hai người cùng sửa một bản ghi, câu lệnh cập nhật phải kiểm tra phiên bản cũ. Nếu số phiên bản đã đổi, trả về xung đột và yêu cầu hợp nhất thay vì ghi đè.
